character.description: Young Vietnamese woman server with large warm brown eyes, dark hair in a neat low bun with a small warm-colored hair clip, teal short-sleeve blouse, dark green apron, dark trousers and black work shoes. Keep her original face, uniform and proportions.

work_serve.action: Four-frame serving loop from her existing front three-quarter view: hold a small dark oval serving tray in both hands at chest height, carefully make a compact presenting gesture as if setting an order down, then return to the exact opening pose. Keep her face, bun, teal blouse and green apron consistent. Feet stay on one ground pivot; no full walking. No plate, customer, table, map or background. Flat magenta background.

rest_tired.action: A subtle four-frame tired rest loop at a safe standing rest point: shoulders lower, wipe forehead with a small clean towel, exhale, then return close to the relaxed opening pose. Feet planted, stable body scale and ground pivot. No walking or active work. Flat magenta background.

idle_lazy.action: A restrained four-frame idle-only loop used only when no work is waiting: briefly take out a small phone, glance at it and tap once, lower it and return to the opening pose. Mildly bored but charming, feet planted, stable scale and pivot. Never use this pose while an active task is waiting. Flat magenta background.

style: Polished painted 2D chibi game character matching existing Banh Mi Pho NPCs, warm natural shading, expressive face, clean dark outline, rich but restrained colors; never pixel art.
